blocks.tamil_translation: (RA) gave Rasulullah ﷺ a piece of unhusked barley bread. Rasulullah ﷺ said, “This is the first food your father has eaten in the past three days.”

blocks.text:
“In another narration it is said that when the Prophet ﷺ asked his daughter, “What is this?” Hazrat Fatimah (RA) replied, “I baked a loaf of bread. My heart did not like that I should eat alone, leaving you out.”
(Tabarani, Majma' az-Zawa'id)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدِ نِ السَّاعِدِيِّ ﵄ قَالَ: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ بِالْخَنْدَقِ وَهُوَ يَحْفِرُ وَنَحْنُ نَنْقُلُ التُّرَابَ، وَبَصُرَ بِنَا فَقَالَ: اَللّهُمَّ لَا عَيْشَ إِلَّا عَيْشُ اْلآخِرَةِ فَاغْفِرْ لِلْأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الصحة والفراغ ....، رقم:٦٤١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sahl ibn Sa'd Sa'idi (RA) says, “We were with Rasulullah ﷺ during the Battle of the Trench; the Prophet ﷺ was digging the trench while we were taking the earth out of the trench and putting it elsewhere. (In this state) the Prophet ﷺ looked at us and made Du'a, “O Allah, the life of the Hereafter is the only life; forgive the Ansar and the Muhajirin!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ بِمَنْكِبِي فَقَالَ: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب قول النبي ﷺ كن في الدنيا كانك غريب....،رقم:٦٤١٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates, “The Prophet ﷺ (drawing my attention towards himself) took hold of my shoulder and said, “Live in the world like a stranger or like a traveller!”
